# Radiation Brawl Event Guide

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_51_nukaknights-post-strahlschlaegerei.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Update December 8th, 2021: NPCs can again be healed with flame weapons e.g. kebab knives.**

Unfortunately, it very often happens that the event fails because the **lowest reward level** is not reached. That's why I'm describing here in the Nuka Knights FB group how you can prevent this.

## GOALS

- 
 5,15,30 or 50 ores (reward level 1-4) to collect (1-2 players must collect ores, as each can collect a maximum of 40 pieces)
- 
 Keeping at least 1 of the 4 NPCs alive (here at least 2+ players have to intercept the enemies in front and behind and, if necessary, heal the NPCs with a kebab knife)

**Important: If no ores are collected and level 1 is not reached, the event will fail.**

## REWARDS

From level 3 there are chances of receiving the rare rewards:

- 
 **Radioactive Barrel** (2.5% drop chance)
- 
 **Emmett Mountain Radiation Protection Suit** (2.5% drop chance)

## HISTORY

After arriving in Emmett Mountain, check how much time you still have to speak to Marion Copeland. **Wait to speak** until about 60-30 seconds before the end so that as many players as possible can join and don't duck so that other players see you in the event and join. During this time you can **prepare** and e.g.

- 
 Equip "Cheer Up" under Charisma (to heal NPCs with the kebab knife)
- 
 Chem fanatics under Endurance (so that RadAway lasts longer when collecting ores)
- 
 Put on power armor or Chinese camouflage suit

Then make sure that there is someone in front of and behind the NPCs to fend off the enemies. Once this is taken care of, you can go into the mines and collect ores. At least 2 players must give up ores to reach the best level. Only 40 ores can be collected per player, 50 are required. 5 are necessary so that the event does not fail. However, at level 3 you can get the highest reward.

Players in PA should take on the role of ore collector without thinking twice.

If enemies get through to the NPCs and injure them, someone with the "Cheer" card under Charisma and a kebab knife has to heal these NPCs back up. It's best not to let the enemies get that far, then no one has to be healed up.

Collecting the ores will expose you to **radiation of up to 500 RAD**. This is hard on even power armor and radiation protection suits. So **RadAway** should be on the shortcut key and eaten like candies when collecting. Chem-Fanatic supports RadAways and saves resources.

If everything is done and the NPCs are still alive, you have a chance at the rare rewards. You will also receive **4 government bonds**.

So team play and thinking are required here so that the event can be completed successfully.

## XP Farming (Leveling)

Of course, the event is also or especially popular because of the many opponents and therefore a lot of XP. Of course there is nothing wrong with that. As long as at least 5 ore have been collected, you can still collect a lot of XP and the event will be successfully completed.

You can find out more about collecting maximum XP and leveling up faster in our article: Faster and better leveling - solo and in a team
